info.title: coveragex
info.description: CLI for .NET incremental coverage workflows built on dotnet-coverage, Git diff analysis, and ReportGenerator.Core.

options.name: --report-directory
options.description: Override the generated report output directory.

options.name: --report-input-files
options.description: Provide one or more explicit coverage XML input files separated by ';'. Repeatable.

options.name: --report-input-directories
options.description: Provide one or more directories separated by ';'. CoverageX recursively scans each provided directory for *.xml files. Repeatable.

options.name: --runtime-branch
options.description: Provide the branch that the running project actually used to produce the coverage XML. If omitted, CoverageX uses --source.

options.name: --repository-url
options.description: Provide a cloneable Git repository URL. CoverageX uses it to materialize the runtime managed source tree when it is missing.

options.name: --repository-username
options.description: Provide the repository username for authenticated HTTP(S) clone, or override the SSH username when using ssh:// URLs.

options.name: --source-directory
options.description: Optionally override the managed clone directory. When provided, CoverageX uses it as the managed runtime source tree location.

options.name: --nopull
options.description: Use the existing source-directory Git working tree as-is without clone, fetch, or checkout.

options.name: --report-type
options.description: Append a ReportGenerator report type. Repeatable.

options.name: --assembly-filter
options.description: Append an explicit assembly filter. Repeatable.

options.name: --class-filter
options.description: Append an explicit class filter. Repeatable.

options.name: --file-filter
options.description: Append an explicit file filter. Repeatable.

options.name: --filter-mode
options.description: Choose diff, merge, or explicit filter behavior.

options.name: --history-directory
options.description: Provide the report history directory.

options.name: --title
options.description: Override the generated report title.

options.name: --tag
options.description: Attach a tag value to the generated report.

options.name: --json
options.description:
Write structured JSON output.
coverage input resolution:
When --source-directory is omitted, CoverageX uses the default managed source tree directory under ~/.coveragex/source-tree/<runtime-branch>.
--source-directory uses the provided directory as the managed clone directory when specified.
--nopull requires --source-directory and uses the existing Git working tree without clone, fetch, or checkout.
source, target, and runtime-branch currently support branch names only.
If --runtime-branch is omitted, CoverageX uses --source as the runtime branch.
CoverageX resolves source/target Git branches directly from the effective runtime source tree and does not fetch missing branches automatically.
CoverageX does not perform an extra checkout step after selecting the runtime source tree.
For freshly cloned managed source trees, CoverageX clones runtime-branch directly.
For --nopull or any existing working tree used as-is, the effective runtime source tree must already be on runtime-branch.
If the runtime managed source tree is missing, provide --repository-url so CoverageX can clone the repository automatically.
For private HTTP(S) repositories, also provide --repository-username and --repository-password.
For SSH repositories, CoverageX uses the system git CLI and the current SSH environment (ssh-agent, Keychain, ~/.ssh/config, known_hosts).
Report generation now requires explicit XML inputs.
Use --report-input-files to pass one or more XML files separated by ';'.
Use --report-input-directories to pass one or more directories separated by ';'. CoverageX recursively scans each provided directory for *.xml files.
filter-mode behavior:
diff      Use only diff-derived file/class filters
merge     Combine diff-derived and explicit file/class filters
explicit  Use only explicit file/class filters

coverage input resolution:
--source-directory is required and must already be a Git working tree root.
source, target, and runtime-branch currently support branch names only.
If --runtime-branch is omitted, CoverageX uses --source as the runtime branch.
The current local HEAD must match --runtime-branch; detached HEAD is rejected.
CoverageX resolves source/target Git branches directly from the effective runtime source tree and does not fetch missing branches automatically.
Report generation now requires explicit XML inputs.
Use --report-input-files to pass one or more XML files separated by ';'.
Use --report-input-directories to pass one or more directories separated by ';'. CoverageX recursively scans each provided directory for *.xml files.
filter-mode behavior:
diff      Use only diff-derived file/class filters
merge     Combine diff-derived and explicit file/class filters
explicit  Use only explicit file/class filters
